ModMetaData.name: Genepacks Injection
ModMetaData.author: Tommaso Belluzzo
ModMetaData.description:
This mod allows genepacks to be injected directly into pawns without messing with xenogerms and xenotypes. Colonists can inject genepacks into themselves or forcibly administer them to prisoners and slaves.
Injected genes can be added as xenogenes (the default behavior) or endogenes, depending on the configuration. The genepack's genes are merged into the recipient's genetic pool: only missing genes are added. The genepack is consumed once the injection is performed, and the recipient enters xenogermination coma.
